description: Rallly lets you create a poll of possible meeting times and share it so participants can vote on when they are available. It can be used online or self-hosted.

name: Appointlet
tagline: Booking pages and meeting scheduling for teams
description: Appointlet is an online scheduling tool that lets clients book meetings from a booking page, with calendar sync, video conferencing links and team scheduling.

name: Payhip
tagline: Sell digital downloads, courses and memberships from your own store
description: Payhip is an e-commerce platform for creators to sell digital products, online courses, coaching, memberships and physical goods, with built-in checkout and EU VAT handling.

name: Ko-fi
tagline: Accept tips, memberships and shop sales from supporters
description: Ko-fi lets creators receive one-off donations, monthly memberships, commissions and shop sales from fans through a simple page.

name: Outseta
tagline: All-in-one memberships, billing, CRM and email for SaaS and creators
description: Outseta bundles payments, subscription billing, authentication, CRM, email and help desk into one tool for membership sites and early-stage SaaS businesses.

name: SendOwl
tagline: Sell and deliver digital products, subscriptions and memberships
description: SendOwl is a checkout and delivery platform for selling digital downloads, subscriptions, memberships and courses, with integrations for existing websites.

name: Big Cartel
tagline: Simple online stores for artists and makers
description: Big Cartel is an e-commerce platform for independent artists and makers to set up an online shop and sell their products.

name: Freemius
tagline: Monetization platform for WordPress plugins, themes and SaaS
description: Freemius handles checkout, licensing, subscriptions, updates and analytics for developers selling WordPress plugins, themes and software.

name: Open Collective
tagline: Transparent fundraising and expense management for groups
description: Open Collective lets communities, open-source projects and groups raise and spend money transparently, with public budgets and fiscal hosting.

name: Liberapay
tagline: Recurring donations platform run as a non-profit
description: Liberapay is an open-source, non-profit platform for receiving recurring donations, commonly used by open-source developers and creators.

name: Podia
tagline: Sell courses, digital downloads, webinars and memberships
description: Podia is an all-in-one platform for creators to sell online courses, digital downloads, coaching, webinars and memberships, with built-in email marketing and a website builder.

name: Invoice Ninja
tagline: Open-source invoicing, quotes, payments and time tracking
description: Invoice Ninja is an invoicing and billing app for freelancers and small businesses, with quotes, recurring invoices, online payments, expenses and time tracking. Available hosted or self-hosted.

name: Akaunting
tagline: Open-source online accounting for small businesses
description: Akaunting is open-source accounting software for small businesses and freelancers, covering invoicing, expenses, bank accounts and financial reports. It can be used in the cloud or self-hosted.

name: Manager
tagline: Accounting software for small businesses, desktop or cloud
description: Manager is accounting software for small businesses with invoicing, bookkeeping, inventory, payroll and reports. A free desktop edition is available alongside server and cloud editions.

name: Plutio
tagline: All-in-one business app for freelancers: projects, proposals, invoices
description: Plutio combines project management, proposals, contracts, invoicing, time tracking and a client portal in one app for freelancers and small agencies.

name: Monica
tagline: Open-source personal CRM to remember details about people
description: Monica is an open-source personal relationship manager that helps you keep track of friends, family and contacts, including notes, reminders and important dates.

name: Capsule CRM
tagline: Simple CRM for small businesses to manage contacts and sales
description: Capsule is a CRM for small businesses to organize contacts, track sales pipelines, manage tasks and integrate with tools like email and accounting software.

name: Less Annoying CRM
tagline: Simple, affordable CRM for small businesses
description: Less Annoying CRM is a straightforward CRM for small businesses to manage contacts, leads, pipelines, tasks and calendars without complex setup.

name: EspoCRM
tagline: Open-source CRM you can self-host or use in the cloud
description: EspoCRM is an open-source CRM for managing contacts, leads, opportunities, cases and email, with customizable entities and workflows.

name: OnePageCRM
tagline: Action-focused CRM for small sales teams
description: OnePageCRM is a sales CRM built around a next-action to-do list, helping small businesses follow up on leads and deals.

name: Crisp
tagline: Live chat, shared inbox and help center for small businesses
description: Crisp is a customer messaging platform with website live chat, a shared team inbox, chatbots and a knowledge base for small and medium businesses.

name: Enchant
tagline: Help desk with shared inbox, knowledge base and messenger
description: Enchant is customer service software that combines a shared inbox for email, social and chat with a knowledge base, aimed at growing support teams.

name: FreeScout
tagline: Free open-source, self-hosted help desk and shared mailbox
description: FreeScout is an open-source help desk and shared inbox that you host yourself, with optional paid modules for extra features.

name: Chatra
tagline: Live chat and messaging for small online businesses
description: Chatra is a live chat app for websites and online stores, with chatbots, saved replies and a shared inbox for messages from multiple channels.

name: Olark
tagline: Live chat software for sales and support teams
description: Olark provides a website live chat widget with chat transcripts, CRM integrations and reporting for small sales and support teams.

name: HelpDocs
tagline: Hosted knowledge base and help center software
description: HelpDocs lets teams build and host a searchable knowledge base or help center for customers or internal documentation.

name: HelpKit
tagline: Turn Notion pages into a help center or knowledge base
description: HelpKit turns your Notion pages into a hosted, searchable help center and documentation site with a support widget.

name: We Work Remotely
tagline: Job board for remote jobs
description: We Work Remotely is a job board listing remote jobs in programming, design, customer support, marketing and other fields.

name: Remotive
tagline: Curated remote job listings
description: Remotive is a remote job board and community listing curated remote positions in tech, support, marketing and more.

name: Working Nomads
tagline: Curated list of remote jobs for digital nomads
description: Working Nomads is a job board that curates remote job listings for people who want to work from anywhere.

name: Himalayas
tagline: Remote job board with company profiles and salary info
description: Himalayas is a remote job board where job seekers can find remote jobs and companies, and employers can post openings.

name: Niceboard
tagline: Software to launch and run your own job board
description: Niceboard is a platform for creating and monetizing niche job boards, with job posting payments, employer accounts and job alerts.

name: Dynamite Jobs
tagline: Remote job board with vetted listings
description: Dynamite Jobs is a remote job board listing vetted remote positions from remote-first companies.

name: Timetastic
tagline: Staff leave and holiday planner for small businesses
description: Timetastic helps small businesses manage staff holiday and leave requests, approvals and a shared absence calendar.

name: Zulip
tagline: Open-source team chat organized by topic threads
description: Zulip is an open-source team chat app that organizes conversations into streams and topics, making async discussion easier to follow. Available as cloud or self-hosted.

name: Campfire
tagline: Self-hosted group chat you buy once
description: Campfire is a group chat app from 37signals with rooms, direct messages and file sharing, which you install on your own server.

name: Twist
tagline: Asynchronous team communication organized in threads
description: Twist is a team messaging app from Doist that organizes discussions into threads, designed for calmer, async communication in remote teams.

name: Geekbot
tagline: Async standups and team check-ins in Slack and Teams
description: Geekbot runs asynchronous standup meetings, surveys and retrospectives inside Slack or Microsoft Teams, collecting answers from each team member.

name: DocuSeal
tagline: Open-source document filling and e-signing
description: DocuSeal is an open-source platform for creating fillable PDF forms and collecting e-signatures, available hosted or self-hosted with an API.

name: SignWell
tagline: Simple electronic signatures for small businesses
description: SignWell lets you send documents for electronic signature, use templates and track signing status, with an API for developers.

name: OpenSign
tagline: Open-source document e-signature platform
description: OpenSign is an open-source e-signature tool for sending, signing and managing documents, available in the cloud or self-hosted.

name: Better Proposals
tagline: Create, send and e-sign business proposals
description: Better Proposals is software for creating web-based proposals, quotes and contracts from templates, with e-signatures, payments and tracking.

name: Flarum
tagline: Free, open-source forum software
description: Flarum is a lightweight, extensible open-source forum platform that you host yourself.

name: NodeBB
tagline: Open-source community forum built on Node.js
description: NodeBB is open-source forum software built on Node.js with real-time discussions, plugins and themes, available self-hosted or as a hosted service.

name: Talkyard
tagline: Community forum, Q&A and blog comments in one
description: Talkyard is open-source software for community discussions, question-and-answer forums, team chat and blog comments, available hosted or self-hosted.

name: Ruzuku
tagline: Simple platform to create and sell online courses
description: Ruzuku is an online course platform for coaches and educators to build, sell and run courses with community discussions.

name: Teachery
tagline: Build and sell online courses with a simple editor
description: Teachery is a platform for creating and selling online courses, with sales pages and payment handling for independent course creators.

name: Tito
tagline: Ticketing for conferences and events
description: Tito is an event ticketing platform for selling tickets to conferences, meetups and workshops, with check-in tools and attendee management.

name: pretix
tagline: Open-source ticket shop for events
description: pretix is open-source ticketing software for selling tickets and handling registration for events, available hosted or self-hosted.

name: Hi.Events
tagline: Open-source event management and ticketing
description: Hi.Events is an open-source platform for selling event tickets and managing attendees, available hosted or self-hosted.

name: Ticket Tailor
tagline: Online ticket selling for event organizers
description: Ticket Tailor is an online box office for selling event tickets with a flat-fee model, seating plans, check-in apps and box office tools.

name: Snipe-IT
tagline: Open-source IT asset management
description: Snipe-IT is open-source software for tracking IT assets, licenses, accessories and consumables, self-hosted or as a hosted service.

name: InvenTree
tagline: Open-source inventory management for parts and stock
description: InvenTree is an open-source inventory management system for tracking parts, stock, suppliers and purchase orders, popular with makers and small manufacturers.

name: Microns
tagline: Marketplace to buy and sell micro-startups
description: Microns is a marketplace where founders list small online businesses and side projects for sale to buyers.

name: SideProjectors
tagline: Marketplace to buy and sell side projects
description: SideProjectors is a marketplace for listing, buying and selling side projects, domains and small online businesses.

name: BetaList
tagline: Directory of new startups looking for early users
description: BetaList is a directory where startups launch and early adopters discover new products.

name: World Time Buddy
tagline: Time zone converter for scheduling across cities
description: World Time Buddy is a time zone converter and meeting planner that shows multiple cities side by side to find overlapping hours.

name: Every Time Zone
tagline: Visual time zone converter for distributed teams
description: Every Time Zone shows the current time across time zones on a single slider so remote teams can pick meeting times.
